currency.hint: Salaries, fees and commission splits are all stored in this currency.

stages.heading: YOUR BOARD COLUMNS · {{count}}
stages.eyeHint: The eye marks stages your clients can see in their portal
stages.fixedNote: First and last stages are fixed — every candidate enters at the first and a hire ends at the last. Everything between is yours to shape.
stages.fixed: Entry and hire stages cannot be removed

reasons.why: Recruiters pick one of these when they close a candidate out — it's what makes the rejection report worth reading.

candidate.label: Candidate withdrew
candidate.hint: the ones you can sometimes save

reasons.untick: Untick anything your agency doesn't use

roleNotes.admin: everything, including billing, fee terms and the audit log
roleNotes.profile-lead: their own clients end to end — reviews CVs, submits, runs offers
roleNotes.sourcer: assigned requirements only; can shortlist but not submit to clients
roleNotes.finance: placements, invoices and commission splits — no candidate data
